entities.summary: Shingo Natsume (b. 1980, Aomori Prefecture) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Aomori Prefecture and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, painters & sculptors, asia.
